summary: Handles an unknown critical PNG chunk. First evaluates the chunk against the control byte at this+0x10C via sub_517FD0; when bit 5 (0x20) of that byte is clear it calls DoubleBufferInit with the 'unknown critical chunk' string and the processing block runs when a2 is non-zero. Inside the block it conditionally sets the done bit 0x8 on the flag register at this+0x58 (only when bit 0x4 is already set) and runs the CRC error check sub_518828 before returning.

local_names.a2: guard input tested after the double-buffer guard call

operations.description: Call sub_517FD0(a1, (uint8_t*)(a1 + 0x10C)) to evaluate the chunk type flags against the control byte at this+0x10C

Guard: read the flag register dword at this+0x58; the done bit 0x8 is only set when bit 0x4 is already set
When the guard passes, write the flag register back to this+0x58 with bit 0x8 set (v4 | 8)
Run the CRC error check sub_518828(a1, a3); its return value is returned as the function result
Return: when the guard fails, return the DoubleBufferInit result; called from sub_5119E9 (0x005119E9)
